title: Indigenous Language Mentorship II
description: A 100-hour mentorship with a fluent speaker or speakers to build oral fluency in an Indigenous language at the second-year level.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of IED258, LING 258.
Subject to the "Guidelines for Ethical Conduct" and "Regulations Concerning Practica"

items.text: admission to one of BEd or Diploma program in Indigenous Language Revitalization, Certificate in Indigenous Language Proficiency, Certificate in Indigenous Language Revitalization
